title: ESA Aeolus × Starlink-44 near-miss (avoided)
recommendation: NO MANEUVER — Pc below action threshold.

documented.maneuver: orbit raise, ~half an orbit before TCA, thruster burns 10:14/10:17/10:18 UTC
documented.lead_time: decision made the day before; detected ~5 days ahead
documented.note: First ESA collision-avoidance maneuver against an active constellation satellite. ESA raised Aeolus; coordination with SpaceX failed (paging bug).
